comment: The pinned orchard release. Edited only by a deliberate update, never to silence a failure. assets[] are download hashes and change when an archive is repacked; files[] are content hashes and change only when the words do. v1.1.0 changed every archive hash and no content hash. v1.9.0 ships no gloss for a word the game refuses, so definitions.tsv loses 323 rows, and gives thousand the numeral's etymology, so etymology.tsv moves by one row; no other content hash does. Every archive was repacked, so every download hash moves. No file was added. See scripts/update-lexicon.ts.
